title: Onboard invited members without implied permission grants
description:
As an account owner, I want explicit onboarding and invitation acceptance.

Feature: Onboard invited members without implied permission grants
  Scenario: Observable acceptance
    Given an approved invitation design and authorized membership operations
    When a recipient accepts an invitation
    Then only the reviewed account role and product entitlements are granted with auditable history

Planning only. No new implementation, deployment, paid call or permission is authorized by this record.

## Current next-step plan — 2026-10-17

Ordered next after hosted account acceptancekanbus-6cf11d42. Requested workflow: an authorized owner invites a member; acceptance, expiry/replay and revocation must preserve account/product scope and audit history.

Feature: Explicit invitation acceptance
  Scenario: Accept within reviewed role scope
    Given an approved invitation design and an inviter with fresh member-management authority
    When the intended authenticated recipient accepts the unexpired invitation
    Then only the named account role/product permission is granted and acceptance is auditable/idempotent
  Scenario: Expired revoked or unauthorized invite
    Given expired/revoked invitation or missing inviter authority
    When acceptance is attempted
    Then no membership or product access is granted

Delivery/identity/role details and any new outbound service scope await implementation-owner review. No message is sent by this planning task. Billing/credits do not gate this path.

Authority: Ryan requested this plan as the permanent Kanbus record. This action updates documentation only. The desired product outcomes are requested priorities, not claims of implementation or hosted acceptance. Existing implementation owners retain their approvals; recommendations needing further scope, release, permission or migration direction stay explicitly gated. No feature code, deployment, paid call, permission change or unrelated merge is performed here.
